title: Best AI Chatbot in 2026: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok Tested
summary: Best AI chatbot in 2026 depends on your use case. We tested ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and Meta AI on coding, reasoning, writing, and value — here's the honest ranking.
body_markdown: Free tiers use smaller models with lower message limits — Claude's free tier gets Haiku, not Opus 4.6; ChatGPT's free tier gets GPT-4o, not GPT-5.5 Thinking. Paid tiers ($20/month for both Claude Pro and ChatGPT Plus) unlock the flagship models, longer context windows, and higher daily limits. For serious daily professional use, the upgrade pays for itself.
